text:
maria_csm: Heads-up  ThamesBio renewal in ~6w. Prod volume dropped ~80% overnight. Dash: https://dash.redwood.internal/thamesbio
metrics-bot: ALERT ThamesBio-prod requests -80% (24h). No 5xx spike. Top impacted: /embed, /annotate.
kevin_sales: They mentioned evaluating RiverWave in the last call. Logged a competitive pilot in SFDC.
zoe_eng: Quick look  no infra deploys on the drop date. KV hit/latency steady for remaining traffic.
sam_se: Support ticket shows client toggled routing to an internal vector store and changed batch-size 2026-05-20. Attached config in ticket #7211.
maria_csm: That indicates partial migration + active competitor trial. Recommend triage: 1) 20-30m sync with ML lead; 2) 1-pager cost vs latency for their top flow; 3) offer timeboxed Dedicated credit + A/B pilot; 4) rollback runbook.
kevin_sales: Sales prefers 4-week metered credit tied to the joint tech session. I'll draft terms.
zoe_eng: I can run the tech session Wed 9am PT (30m). Will prepare a short runbook for reverting routing + prefix cache tips.
sam_se: I'll attach the client's config snapshots and the support trace to the ticket. Also spotted a vector-dim mismatch that may silently drop embed calls.
billing-bot: Billing hold requires formal written request from customer + finance approval. Use /billing/hold-request.
paula_finance: Finance needs written customer request + evidence of migration to consider a hold. We can fast-track review if provided.
maria_csm: Actions: Kevin  draft credit & commercial wording; Zoe  tech deck + runbook; Sam  attach evidence to ticket; Maria  prep cost brief & internal renewal note. Mark renewal_risk = "elevated".
kevin_sales: I'll post the draft credit by EOD and include contingency language for A/B.
zoe_eng: Deck + runbook uploaded to /shared/cs/thamesbio before Wed.
maria_csm: Invite sent to their ML lead for Wed 9am PT. Please keep updates here; escalate to "high" if usage drops further before sync. :+1:
